svg.text: Worked example — the first 0x171 bytes of the Contents stream of blank.UTSCH (3,752 bytes)
One field per line. Offsets are stream offsets (here file offset = 0x0C00 + stream offset, §1). Indentation follows the nesting of objects; classes and objects share one counter (§3.2).
PTR: new class (FFFF, schema 0x212, name length 11) CDocVariant, then its object
PTR: new class CAttribFontInfo (schema 0x212), then its object
font: PTR, new class CSerialFont (schema 0x064), then its object
italic, underline, strike-out, character set, precisions, quality, pitch and family
… then leftover memory up to 32 bytes; a reader ignores it
nets: COUNT 0 — a blank design has no nets (§10)
value: PTR, new class CShape (schema 0x212), then its object (§5.1)
PTR: new class CSubShape, then its object (§5.2)
PTR: new class CUcRect, then its object (§4.5)
M(CRectangle): first marker of this class — FFFF, schema 0x064, name
… the frame's points follow, then the rest of the CSubShape and CShape, and the remaining items of the body (§6); its last item, a WORD 0, ends the stream at 0x0EA7.
class tag: new class, or first class marker
